profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Masterclass

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Redesigned existing code to improve app organization and structure in JavaScript & Python for educational application, StoryLines. Devised new user experience in JavaScript and Jquery to improve effectiveness of viral marketing. Integrated social media using respective APIs to increase user base and accessibility into StoryLines. Ported application to Android using PhoneGap.

positions.title: Intern for Professor Gerald G Fuller, Rheology and Fluid Dynamics Lab,  Keck Center at Stanford Univ
positions.description: Engineered a device that would help simulate the interaction between two fluids. Took pictures/videos of the interactions between the two fluids. Presented findings to an audience that consisted of parents and other interns.

positions.title: Material Science Lab Summer Intern
positions.description: Manufactured nanowires through chemical processes. Recorded chemical and procedural data on nanowires produced and prepared samples of nanowires for a graduate student's volatile memory research study. Presented data gathered  to an audience of parents and other interns.

projects.title: Ray Tracer Renderer and OpenGL Pipeline Renderer
projects.description: Study and implement both pipeline and ray tracing rendering methods. Learned ray tracing and pipeline rendering methods. Developed ray tracer renderer in stages throughout the semester. Learned OpenGL and developed a pipeline renderer.

projects.title: Amaze: Programming Language for developing 2D mazes
projects.description:
Develop a computer language for creating two-dimensional maze games. Learned theories and implementations of compilers such as those used by C and Java. Designed and developed a functional computer language. Designed and developed a functional compiler for the language.
Presented final project to class.
